violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Red salsa with fresh garlic in ice bath on countertop was temping at 48F at time of inspection. EHS observed red salsa was not fully submerged in ice bath, with ice covering all sides of salsa container.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES. SINCE SALSA HAD ONLY BEEN IN ICE BATH FOR 1 HOUR, PIC RE-DID THE ICE BATH WITH FRESH ICE AND WATER. PIC PLACED THE RED SALSA IN THE FRESH ICE BATH WITH THE CONTAINER BEING FULLY SUBMERGED WITH ICE SURROUNDING ALL SIDES TO COOL BACK TO 41.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: In 1DR UPR cooler had raw fish being stored above ready to eat cooked chicken, cooked corn and ready to eat guacamole. In the walk-in refrigerator, raw shell eggs were being stored over ready to eat produce.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL RAW FOODS MUST BE STORED BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS IN ANY COOLER TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CROSS CONTAMINATION. PIC MOVED ALL RAW FOODS BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS IN THE 1DR UPR COOLER AND THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 2DR PREP TOP: cooked beef was being stored above raw beef. WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR: raw shell eggs were being stored above cooked beef.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS PROVIDED MORE INFORMATION ON HOW RAW FOODS AND COOKED FOODS SHOULD BE STORED. PIC HAS EMPLOYEES MOVE ALL RAW FOODS BELOW COOKED FOODS IN BOTH THE 2DR PREP TOP AND WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
